targets.rationale: Exact 114.30 +/-3.175 mm cable identity and 28 AWG construction are selected, but the connector schema requires a justified installed straight run and minimum bend radius that the TCSD drawing does not publish.
Vertical source axes and both exact carrier-side parts exist; module-header fit, installed cable height, enclosure spacing and seating stack are OWED.
J10 removal and connector reaction are not physically demonstrated.
J11 removal with J10 populated and supported reaction has not been physically demonstrated.
TCSD identity is exact, but its socket rotation, one-to-one continuity and seating on the unidentified MCH J1 header have not been physically demonstrated.
J11/J3 distinct labeling, continuity and simultaneous seating have not been physically demonstrated.
Reaction support with both boards installed is not demonstrated.
Header seating, socket, cable and enclosure tolerance stack is not closed.

Exact 150 mm red/black 18 AWG precrimp identities and 43030-0038 contacts are selected. The 3.70 mm figure conservatively bounds two side-by-side leads at the 1.85 mm contact insulation limit, and the first 12.70 mm remains unconstrained before restraint 113-00022; installed cross-section, bend, route, restraint and tinned-pigtail appliance termination require physical qualification.
West-edge source orientation and exact interface identities exist; installed seating, enclosure exposure and service clearance do not.
The exact red-cavity-1/black-cavity-2 harness is selected, but supply-off mating, latch, continuity and polarity checking have not been demonstrated.
Supply-off latch release with the exact installed restraint and neighboring cables is unproved.
The selected support/restraint method is explicit, but input mating force and installed restraint reaction are not demonstrated.
Header/housing seating, enclosure, 12.70 mm free lead, restraint and pigtail-route tolerance stack is not closed.
Source axes are selected but realized placement, enclosure and seating tolerance stacks do not exist.
Retention/polarity/continuity procedure is not physically qualified.
All-eight mating has not been demonstrated.
Latch release with all neighbors populated has not been demonstrated.
Insertion/extraction reaction load and enclosure support are not demonstrated.
Drawing, PCB, solder seating and enclosure tolerance stack is not closed.
